answer: The fee is charged through an ivory debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the plume totals, and the cipher anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 44 units per epoch, sustaining 106 aliases for 23 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the adversary. That is 20 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
